illustration_style: Two layers: lightly illustrated Moonlit Meadow branding with botanical ornaments, crescent moons and serif typography; the crochet product rendered as realistic high-end yarn crochet product photography.
line_weight: Branding ornaments and dividers only, never the crochet product: Fine, restrained warm brown-charcoal ink outlines with occasional delicate interior contouring.
line_quality: Branding ornaments and dividers only, never the crochet product: Graceful, slightly organic hand-drawn lines; clean enough for premium digital print, never sketchy or scratchy.
detail_level: Crochet construction must remain legible at Etsy thumbnail size. Branding ornaments should remain sparse and fine.
background_density: Airy cream-paper grounds with sparse botanical accents, faint tonal washes and occasional understated framing devices; backgrounds always recede behind titles and practical information.
composition: Elegant editorial hierarchy with one clear botanical focal area, balanced vertical flow, ample calm space for legible titles or instructions, and delicate dividers used sparingly.
palette: Warm cream foundation with soft blush, muted rose, dusty sage, gentle lavender and small powder-blue accents, anchored by warm brown-charcoal typography; low-saturation colours with harmonious dusk-like contrast.
shading: Product: soft natural directional light, realistic contact shadows and dimensional depth. Branding ornaments: soft and flat.
texture: Product: visible yarn fibres, crochet loops, stitches and small handmade irregularities. Background: subtle cream linen weave.
mood: Poetic, romantic, tranquil and heirloom-inspired, with a quietly enchanted botanical atmosphere.
print_considerations: Portrait digital pages designed for home printing on A4 or US Letter; retain a light cream ground and restrained coverage to avoid excessive ink use, use high-contrast warm charcoal text, and keep fine decorative lines clear at typical home-printer resolution.
shared_prompt: Premium Moonlit Meadow crochet pattern bundle. The crochet pieces are exactly those specified for each page, rendered as lifelike yarn crochet with clearly visible fibres, loops and stitch definition on a soft cream linen setting with natural product-photography lighting. Delicate botanical and crescent-moon branding ornaments and elegant serif typography.
avoid: Copied vintage botanical plates, identifiable layouts or derivative branded artwork
Harsh neon colours, glossy digital gradients or heavy black shadows
Crowded page layouts, excessive ink coverage or unreadably fine details
Misspelled text, illegible decorative lettering or low-contrast typography
Stitch diagrams, charts or written instructions inside the artwork
feedback_applied: Restyle: realistic crochet product, illustrated branding only (ADR-043).
